EPISODE 3
[00:00] INT. BLAKE GROUP BOARDROOM - DAY
[00:01] Board members take their seats. Ryan stands at the head of the table.
[00:05] Emma walks in wearing a sharp black suit.
[00:08] RYAN: Who let the maid in? Security!
[00:11] LILY: She's here to beg for money. How pathetic.
[00:15] Emma ignores them and sits in the chairman's seat.
[00:18] RYAN: That seat is for the majority owner. Get up.
[00:22] EMMA: I know. That's why I'm sitting in it.
[00:25] HARLOW: As of this morning, Ms. Clarke holds fifty-one percent of Blake Group.
[00:30] EMMA: I'm the new owner of Blake Group.
[00:33] A glass slips from Lily's hand and shatters on the floor.
[00:36] The board members stare at Ryan in silence.
[00:39] LILY: That's impossible. She's nobody.
[00:42] EMMA: First order of business. Ryan Blake, you're fired.
[00:46] INT. BOARDROOM CORRIDOR - DAY
[00:47] Ryan grabs Harlow by the arm.
[00:49] HARLOW: Her real name is Emma Sterling. Richard Sterling's only daughter.
[00:54] RYAN: Then who is the woman I married?
[00:58] CUT TO BLACK.
